channelArchivedNoJoin: This channel is archived and can't be joined
channelGeneralNoManager: General is managed by the project's managers and has no manager of its own
channelManagerPersonOnly: A channel's manager must be a person in the project
channelGeneralNoLeave: General includes everyone in the project and can't be left
channelGeneralNotPrivate: General includes everyone in the project and can't be made private
channelPublicProjectManagerOnly: Only the project's managers can make a private channel public
channelJoinToPost: Join this channel to post in it
taskOwnerNotInProject: A task can only be handed to a project member
contributorNotInProject: Only project members can be added as collaborators
routineOwnerNotInProject: {handle} isn't a project member, so the results can't be sent to them
topicMuteUntilPast: The end of a mute must be in the future
channelArchiveOpenTasks: This channel still has open tasks. Close them before archiving it
projectSlugFormat: A short name uses lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 3 to 32 characters, and does not start or end with a hyphen
projectSlugReserved: This short name is kept for a platform page. Choose another
projectSlugTaken: Another project has used this short name. Choose another
acceptFocusTooLong: Review focus takes at most {items} items and {chars} characters in total, one sentence each, saying what the reviewer should check. Test results and how you verified the change go in body
reviewCommentAlreadySent: The comment has been sent and can no longer be changed
reviewCommentNotAwaitingReview: Comments can only be written while the task awaits review
reviewCommentNotAllowed: Only the task's owner, contributors and reviewer can comment
reviewCommentBadLines: The comment's line numbers are invalid
reviewCommentBadPlace: The comment's location in the file is invalid
reviewCommentNotSendable: One of the comments to send can't be sent. Refresh and try again
reviewCommentOutcomeUnknown: The last round of comments has no comment {id}
taskFileEditsOverlap: This file changed after you opened it, in places you changed too. Pick a version for each
fileTooLarge: The file is too large ({mb}MB max)
submissionPastDeadline: Your submission deadline has passed, so no version can be handed in or changed. Ask the challenge's author to extend it
submissionClaimNotApproved: Your claim must be approved before you can hand work in
submissionChallengeEnded: This challenge has ended, so no work can be handed in
